title: Change set
description: A batch of at most 500 ops against one resource, sent with an Idempotency-Key.

jobOrder.description: The job order's id. Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

mission.description: The mission's id. Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

oneOf.description: Books stock in as a new shared entry of the unit's pool, held by a member from the unit's roster.

unit.description: The unit whose pool receives the stock, as the org stock's lots name it.

holder.description: The ref of the holder, from the unit's roster.

mergeScu.description: Merge an SCU material into the holder's entry of the same lot in the pool, as the web's merge opt-in does. Piece-counted stock always merges.

jobOrders.description: Earmarks to job orders that need the material or item.

missions.description: Earmarks to missions; not for an item.

oneOf.description: Books an amount out of one shared entry of the unit's pool.

unit.description: The unit whose pool holds the entry.

entry.description: The entry's id from the org stock. Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

version.description: The entry's version the client last saw. A difference answers VERSION_CONFLICT.

fromJobOrders.description: How much comes out of each job-order earmark of the entry; the rest must be free of job-order earmarks.

fromMissions.description: How much comes out of each mission earmark of the entry; the rest must be free of mission earmarks.

oneOf.description: Sells an amount of one shared entry of the unit's pool; the amounts taken from mission earmarks share the proceeds among those missions.

unit.description: The unit whose pool holds the entry.

entry.description: The entry's id from the org stock. Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

version.description: The entry's version the client last saw. A difference answers VERSION_CONFLICT.

terminal.description: The terminal the stock was sold at.

proceeds.description: The aUEC the sale brought in.

fromJobOrders.description: How much comes out of each job-order earmark of the entry; the rest must be free of job-order earmarks.

fromMissions.description: How much comes out of each mission earmark of the entry; the rest must be free of mission earmarks. Each mission gets its share of the proceeds when the member takes part in it.

oneOf.description: Moves an amount of one shared entry of the unit's pool to another location, keeping holder and pool.

unit.description: The unit whose pool holds the entry.

entry.description: The entry's id from the org stock. Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

version.description: The entry's version the client last saw. A difference answers VERSION_CONFLICT.

mergeScu.description: Merge an SCU material into the holder's entry of the same lot at the new location. Piece-counted stock always merges.

fromJobOrders.description: How much comes out of each job-order earmark of the entry and moves along with it; the rest must be free of job-order earmarks.

fromMissions.description: How much comes out of each mission earmark of the entry and moves along with it; the rest must be free of mission earmarks.

oneOf.description: Moves an amount of one shared entry of the unit's pool to another holder, into the pool of a unit the member is a Logistician of.

entry.description: The entry's id from the org stock. Opaque identifier issued by the Basetool. Clients store and echo it, never parse it.

version.description: The entry's version the client last saw. A difference answers VERSION_CONFLICT.

toUnit.description: The unit whose pool receives the stock; may be unit itself.

holder.description: The ref of the new holder, from the roster of toUnit.

mergeScu.description: Merge an SCU material into the new holder's entry of the same lot in the receiving pool. Piece-counted stock always merges.

fromJobOrders.description: How much comes out of each job-order earmark of the entry and moves along with it; the rest must be free of job-order earmarks.

fromMissions.description: How much comes out of each mission earmark of the entry and moves along with it; the rest must be free of mission earmarks.

oneOf.description: Moves one shared entry of the unit's pool, or a part of its free stock, into the pool of another unit its holder directly belongs to and the member is a Logistician of.

toUnit.description: The unit whose pool receives the stock.

quantity.description: The part to move, taken from the free stock; absent moves the whole entry with its earmarks.

note.description: The new note; absent or blank clears it.

refineryMethodRef.description: A refining method, resolved exactly: first by its code, then by its exact name.

refineryGood.description: One good of an order. The output material follows from the input as in the web: its refined material, else the input itself.

input.description: The input material, RAW or manual-raw, resolved exactly.

outputQuantity.description: The yield in whole units, 100 to the SCU.

refineryOrderVersions.description: The counters of the sections the op touches, as the client last saw them. A difference answers VERSION_CONFLICT.

refineryGameDataVersion.description: The game-data counter the client last saw. A difference answers VERSION_CONFLICT.

location.description: The refinery: a location the web's picker offers.
